title: Detailed cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Saucer -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="34" ry="8" fill="#5B8BB5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="30" ry="6.5" fill="#7FB3D9"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="83" rx="24" ry="4.5" fill="#A8D2EE"/>

  <!-- Cup body -->
  <path d="M22 42 Q20 80 28 82 L72 82 Q80 80 78 42 Z" fill="#E05555"/>
  <!-- Cup body highlight -->
  <path d="M26 46 Q25 76 30 78 L36 78 Q32 72 32 46 Z" fill="#F07878"/>
  <!-- Cup rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="28" ry="7" fill="#F5F5F5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="24" ry="5.5" fill="#8B5A2B"/>

  <!-- Cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="22" ry="4.5" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="18" ry="3.5" fill="#8B5A2B"/>

  <!-- Steam -->
  <path d="M38 34 Q34 26 40 20 Q44 14 40 8" stroke="#D9E8F5" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M50 32 Q46 23 52 17 Q56 11 52 4" stroke="#D9E8F5" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M62 34 Q58 26 64 20 Q68 14 64 8" stroke="#D9E8F5" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M78 50 Q94 50 94 64 Q94 78 78 78" stroke="#E05555" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 50 Q94 50 94 64 Q94 78 78 78" stroke="#F07878" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Marshmallow 1 -->
  <rect x="36" y="38" width="10" height="7" rx="2.5" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
  <rect x="37" y="39" width="8" height="2.5" rx="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Marshmallow 2 -->
  <rect x="52" y="39" width="11" height="7" rx="2.5" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
  <rect x="53" y="40" width="9" height="2.5" rx="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Marshmallow 3 -->
  <rect x="45" y="41" width="8" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFF0D0"/>
  <rect x="46" y="42" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Whipped cream swirl -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="42" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#FFFDF5"/>
  <path d="M54 42 Q54 36 60 35 Q66 36 66 42" fill="#FFFDF5"/>
  <path d="M56 39 Q57 35 60 34 Q63 35 64 39" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Cream highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="37" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Cocoa dusting -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="44" r="0.8" fill="#4A2510"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="43" r="0.7" fill="#4A2510"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="44" r="0.8" fill="#4A2510"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="0.6" fill="#4A2510"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="43" r="0.7" fill="#4A2510"/>
</svg>
